announcements.text: Weldin Construction LLC, North Las Vegas, Nevada, has been awarded a ceiling $185,000,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for Simplified Acquisition of Base Engineering Requirements. This contract provides a streamlined method for completing construction projects. Work will be performed at Nellis Air Force Base; Creech AFB; and the Nevada Test and Training Range; and is expected to be completed by Sept. 29, 2031. This contract was a competitive acquisition and six offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $2,089,542 are being obligated at time of award. The 99th Contracting Squadron, Nellis AFB, Nevada, is the contracting activity (FA4861-26-D0008). (Awarded on Sept. 30, 2026.)

announcements.text: Aegis Aerospace Inc., Webster, Texas, has been awarded a $9,359,118 modification (P00001) to a previously awarded contract (FA8809-26-F-B003) for transitioning missions from the Department of War human-rated payload support task order. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $34,323,859 from $24,964,741. Work will be performed at Houston, Texas, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2034. Fiscal 2026 research and development funds in the amount of $654,507 are being obligated at time of award. The Space Systems Command, Kirtland, Air Force Base, Albuquerque, New Mexico, is the contracting activity.
